summary: You clone your repository into a new folder, use a new empty database and follow only the README, writing each gap in a log before fixing it. The real log from the course's capstone has five gaps: a new database without the pgvector extension, nine tests skipped with no explanation, a template README and tab title, an example that fails for the default role, and a page that never showed sources. The Docker path was not followed.
goal: M15: follow your own README from a fresh clone and fix every gap.

items.text: Prepare the gap log and the rules: new folder, new empty database, only the README
Clone fresh and follow the README line by line, stopping at the first problem
Fix each gap in your working copy, commit, pull into the fresh clone and restart the step
Use the page as a stranger: ask its own example question as the default role
Run the test commands as written and look for silent skips
Look at the tab title, the other README files and the first screen for leftover templates
Play the Fresh Clone game to the end and see your score
